Lemma
[Analytic semigroup for Ricci--DeTurck (Lemma 35.26)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0315, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0316 ↗ lem:chow-iv-deturck-analytic-dependence 1. ch35:35.26\group Maximal Regularity

For every $g\in \mathcal G_\beta $, the strongly elliptic extension $\widetilde{\mathcal A}(g):\mathcal E_1\subset \mathcal E_0\to \mathcal E_0$ generates a strongly continuous analytic semigroup.
